name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao's journey into motorsport was sparked by a childhood fascination with Formula 1, captivated by the blend of cutting-edge technology and human skill. He honed his engineering skills at the National University of Singapore before landing a role with a local racing team, where he quickly distinguished himself through his meticulous data analysis and innovative problem-solving. His reputation led to an offer from Team WRT, where he now plays a crucial role in optimizing vehicle performance and race strategy.

Jian Hao approaches his work with a holistic mindset, focusing not only on the immediate technical challenges but also on the broader implications for the team's overall competitiveness. He's known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, helping drivers extract the maximum potential from their cars. His visionary outlook and commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to the team, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Jian Hao is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Singaporean coffee before every race.
